rationale: The bid-ask spread of 96.4 bps (~$0.16) creates immediate structural friction that eats deeply into any reasonable intraday profit target, making the risk/reward unfavorable before a directional edge even exists. The prior session's extreme range ($14.57–$18.44) reflects unresolved price discovery post-earnings, and with only 2 completed 5-minute candles the session structure is too embryonic to identify a reliable entry level or trend. The elevated relative volume is noted but insufficient alone to overcome the liquidity and spread concerns at this stage.
